---
title: "Steps"
format:
  emiljs:
    keep-emiljs: true
_quarto:
  tests:
    emiljs:
      noErrorsOrWarnings: []
      # steps ride through as emil.js's own markers (SPEC A8, A45), including an
      # empty gate, which carries no content and must not be dropped
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - ['div[data-step]', 'div[data-step-at="2"][data-step-reveal="none"]', 'div[data-step-count="3"].fade', 'div[data-step-for="#chart"]', 'li[data-step]', 'video#clip', 'div[data-step-for="#clip"][data-step-start="0.5"][data-step-end="1.2"]']
      ensureHtmlElementContents:
        - selectors: ['div[data-step-at="2"]']
          matches: ['Kept visible']
      ensureEmiljsFileRegexMatches:
        - ['::: \{\.step at="2" reveal="none"\}', '::: \{\.step for="#chart"\}\n:::', '- A list item \{\.step\}', '::: \{\.step for="#clip" data-step-start="0.5" data-step-end="1.2"\}\n:::']
---

## Constructs

::: {.step}
Plain step
:::

::: {.step at=2 reveal=none}
Kept visible at step 2
:::

::: {.step count=3 .fade}
Three steps, fading
:::

::: {#chart}
The chart
:::

::: {.step for="#chart"}
:::

- A list item {.step}
- A second item

```{=html}
<video id="clip" src="clip.webm" muted playsinline></video>
```

::: {.step for="#clip" data-step-start=0.5 data-step-end=1.2}
:::
